purpose: Define one access boundary for public and authorized-only Package discovery, download, installation, update and local lifecycle management.

manifest.access_policy_ref: Opaque policy reference bound to the declared publication repository; never a credential.

credential_resolution.selection: Use only the credential handle selected for the Package software source.
credential_resolution.github_packages_verification: Authenticated pull-token exchange followed by an authorized OCI manifest read; bind the successful decision to the immutable manifest digest.

explicit_check.persisted_fields: Safe access decision metadata only; never credentials or registry pull tokens.

directory.installed_version_and_local_readiness: Read from the native carrier independently of download access.

authority_boundary.registry: Owns artifact visibility and pull permission.
authority_boundary.framework: Selects the source provider, verifies access and projects safe decisions.
authority_boundary.native_carrier: Owns physical installation, updates, removal and readback.
authority_boundary.studio: Renders Framework state and dispatches declared actions; does not mint grants.

private_publication_admission.trusted_key_owner: Framework first-party trust root or explicit Host configuration
private_publication_admission.key_source: explicit absolute local PEM path takes precedence; otherwise only gaofeng21cn/one-person-lab-private-packages uses the key shipped in contracts/opl-framework/keys/private-package-signing.pub; artifact and overridden projection-directory keys are rejected
private_publication_admission.publisher_key_binding: private publisher derives the protected signing key's public key and requires it to match the Framework-shipped trust root before publication
private_publication_admission.required: verified receipt and signature for the exact authorized OCI digest before remote source admission
private_publication_admission.credential_transport: source-selected provider credential in temporary mode-0700 Docker config directory with mode-0600 config; removed after verification
private_publication_admission.discovery_scope: known owner Package descriptors; no arbitrary GHCR account enumeration
